note: Small, remote Divide RD campground (remodeled 2010) on the South Fork of Rock Creek about 18 miles SW of Monte Vista at ~9,700 ft, with trailhead parking for Trails 702-704: ~12 miles of County Road R, then ~6 miles of graded dirt Forest Road 28 (passenger-car passable, 4x4 not required). Thinly reviewed. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed 7 FCFS sites, vault toilet, no water, $10, phone 719-657-3321 (Divide RD). Max length 30 (note-derived, no source) replaced by the FS page's 40-ft spurs (35-40 ft, dead-end); added season (open year-round, snow/spring closures), 14-day limit, Scan to Pay, senior/access discount. FR 28 Rock Creek 'Open' on the Divide RD road table (updated 2026-06-11). Pin ~60 m from the FS point, on the FR 28 bench. Note trimmed of length, toilet/water and fee facts.
flags: Waterfront not re-audited: the campground lies on a narrow bench between FR 28 and the South Fork of Rock Creek (the creek runs ~20-40 m south of the road at the pin), so it may earn creekside, but the sites can't be made out on the imagery (shadowed, conifer cover) and there is no per-site catalog. Stored 'not waterfront' left alone.

The '4x4 not required / passenger-car passable' claim in the note has no agency source; the FS page gives no road advice beyond the directions, and the district road table lists FSR 28 Rock Creek as Open.
